manual_notes: The backpressure change is corroborated by demand/capacity-bounded pull requests, bounded FIFO/overflow NAKs, per-stream limits, lag/ack/throughput telemetry and retention-risk signals. Inspected tests cover bounds and pull payload configuration. Sizing evidence and local replay/CNPG/Rust harnesses are present; the 50k-agent model documents a bottleneck, not a claim that 50k capacity is achieved. June 17 is the recovered benchmark-delivery event.
rationale: The selected change is a bounded ingestion repair plus observability and evaluation design. Direct production code, targeted tests and actual benchmark artifacts support that scope. The design explicitly delegates future edge-anomaly/raw-storage decisions and does not require proven 50k-agent throughput.

sources.observed_facts: Inspected producer request budget=min(demand,remaining buffer capacity), FIFO queue, overflow NAK, omission of push deliver_subject, per-stream batch/ack limits, consumer lag reporter, low-cardinality telemetry including retention risk, config/flow-control/consumer tests, fixture replay and rollback-default CNPG benchmark code. sizing.md records measured payload/rate/row fanout and database write benchmarks, partition ownership/failover model and scaling proof gaps.

Inspected standalone Rust protobuf benchmark controls and documentation separating production BEAM/ERTS repair from experimental controls. Harness consumes captured fixtures, separates phases, disables database writes unless explicitly configured and targets a temporary benchmark table.

limitations: Static source/test review only; no tests, benchmarks, deployments or production systems were run.
Evidence uses recovered public GitHub path-history commits. Their equivalence to the original dataset revision is not asserted; no completion date is inferred from the last specification edit.
Benchmark results are repository-author reports and were not independently reproduced.
Outcome date denotes the observed recovered public delivery of the benchmark portion, not exact developer completion or production deployment.
Existing raw-log taxonomy and every OTEL field were not independently regression-tested; review focused on this change's pull/backpressure/telemetry/evaluation additions.
review_depth: Read full selected specification/shared tasks; inspected substantive producer/consumer/config/telemetry implementation, flow-control and config test assertions, sizing calculations/results and local benchmark safety/data paths. Tests and benchmarks were not run.
